description: Links for valid tsquare wireframe text, the same kinds as the playground's Copy link menu: a share link that opens it in the playground for editing, SVG and PNG image links, Markdown and HTML. Returns an SVG image link and the share link unless `links` asks for others. Each link contains the whole wireframe text (compressed), so anyone with a link can read it.

flows.description: Draw flow arrows (default true). false leaves them out, as if there were no flow lines.

links.description: Which links to return. Each link is long, since it carries the whole wireframe. share: open and edit it in the playground. svg: an image link to view or embed (Notion, GitHub, docs). png: an image link for tools that don't show SVG. markdown: an image for READMEs and docs. html: an tag for web pages. Default [svg, share].

text.description: The wireframe in tsquare text (a ```tsquare code fence around it is fine).

name: share_wireframe
title: Share a wireframe
